sentence_stem: If I had studied harder for the exam,
correct_completion: I would be working in a better job now.
full_sentence: If I had studied harder for the exam, I would be working in a better job now.
acceptable_variants: I would have a better job now.
I would be earning more money now.

options.text: I would have a better job now.
options.why_wrong: 'Would have' refers to a past result. The sentence has 'now', so the present result form 'would be working' is needed.

options.text: I would be working in a better job now.
I will work in a better job now.
options.why_wrong: The first clause is an unreal past condition, so the main clause needs 'would', not the real future 'will'.

options.text: I work in a better job now.
options.why_wrong: This is a simple statement of fact. It does not form the result of an unreal past condition.

grammar_focus: Mixed conditional: past unreal condition with a present result
explanation: The if-clause describes an unreal past situation with the past perfect, while the result is in the present, so the main clause uses would plus a present form. Turkish speakers often use the same verb tense in both clauses because Turkish marks conditional meaning with suffixes rather than separate tense pairs.
translation: Sınav için daha çok çalışsaydım, şimdi daha iyi bir işte çalışıyor olurdum.
